task_message:
Case M24: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 280x280x330 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case M24 is finished. The final mask (v2) segments the myxoid soft-tissue tumor as a single 698 mL component:

- **Findings:** The lesion is a large, lobulated T2-hyperintense mass with a thin dark pseudocapsule, occupying most of the limb cross-section at its mid-level and tapering inferiorly along the fascial planes.
- **Workflow:** After scanning with axial/coronal/sagittal contact sheets, I seeded the model with three positive points in the bright core (axial slice 167), removed five tiny stray components with `keep_component`, then verified coverage at the superior end (axial 255–296), inferior end (axial 0–90), and all three planes including zoomed mask crops.
- **Candidates:** All five automatic proposals (C1–C5) traced the peripheral subcuticular/fascial bright band and thin vessels rather than tumor tissue, so they were rejected.
- **Confidence:** Medium — the tumor core and capsular boundary are clearly followed in all three planes; the only uncertainty is the exact distal extent of the tapering fascial tail at the very bottom of the field of view.
